append: Match the speaker and the ORDERED source and target propositions before applying a denial or withdrawal. Withdrawing P implies Q says nothing about Q implies P, which remains unsupported and unrefuted unless separately stated. A withdrawn denial stays withdrawn when later turns discuss other matters; unrelated speech does not reinstate it. Negation inside P or Q is part of that proposition, not a denial of the whole directed relation. Reporting another person's stance without endorsement is not the reporter's denial.
